utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Please be seated. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Case number IT-05-88/2-A, the Prosecutor versus Mr. Tolimir.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Let me begin by ensuring that the audio equipment is functioning properly. Mr. Tolimir, can you hear the proceedings in a language you understand? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Tolimir. Prosecution, can you hear the proceedings in a language you understand?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Appearances by the parties. For the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. MILANINIA
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. Nema Milaninia on behalf of the Prosecution, together with my colleague Mr. Kyle Wood, and our Case Manager, Ms. Janet Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. For Mr. Tolimir. Of course, you are self-represented and -- THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. President. I'm Tolimir, and I'm accompanied by my legal assistant and representative, Dr. Aleksandar Gajic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Tolimir, and thank you, Mr. Gajic. The right of audience, you will recall, of Mr. Gajic has been limited to addressing legal or administrative issues during Status Conferences. As you are aware, Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days after the filing of a Notice of Appeal and, thereafter, within 120 days after the last Status Conference for each appellant in the Tribunal's custody. A Status Conference serves two primary purposes: First, it allows appellants an opportunity to express concerns relating to their appeal or detention conditions. Second, it provides an opportunity to update the appellants with respect to the status of their case. The Status Conference is also an opportunity for the Tribunal to inquire about the mental and physical condition of the detained persons. In the present case, the last Status Conference was held on 25 February 2014. Thus, this Status Conference is taking place before the expiration of the 120-day period specified in the Rule 65 bis (B). Today's Status Conference was scheduled by the Scheduling Order issued on 13 May 2014. I turn to the health of the appellant. Let me ask you, Mr. Tolimir, about your health. And, if you wish, I can close the session to enable you to speak in privacy. Would you like me to close the hearing? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. President. There is no need to go into closed session because I don't really want to say anything that has to do with my medical condition or the state of my health. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Tolimir. Then we will proceed with an open session. Let me turn to recent procedural history. Update on the case. During the last Status Conference on 25 February 2014, as Pre-Appeal Judge, I ordered Mr. Tolimir and the Prosecution to file public versions of their briefs by 27 March 2014, redacting any confidential information. The public redacted versions of all the relevant briefs have been duly filed. Pursuant to the Appeals Chamber decision of 20 June 2014, in response to Mr. Tolimir's request, his legal advisor, Mr. Gajic, has been authorised to make oral submissions at the appeal hearings. Issues raised by the parties. Do parties have any other issues that they would like to raise at this time? Let me first turn to the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. MILANINIA
utterances.text: No, Mr. President, we have no issues at this time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Prosecutor. Mr. Tolimir, do you have any other issues that you would like to raise? I see that Mr. Gajic is signaling no answer. So there are no -- THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: So there are no issues. Mr. Tolimir, you would like to say something? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. I don't have anything to say.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Tolimir. Since there are no other matters to be raised, I thank the parties for their attendance and call the proceedings to a close.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at 3.25 p.m.
